lights.title: Health check
lights.tapHint: Tap a check to see what it means.

cash.name: Bank balance
cash.ask: Will the money run out soon?
cash.explain: How many months the company can pay its bills before its cash runs out.
cash.G: Profitable, or 12 months or more of cash.

customers.name: Customers
customers.explain: Are more paying customers arriving than leaving, and do most of them stay?
customers.G: More customers arriving than leaving, and 75% or more stay.
customers.R: Losing more customers than it wins, or few sign-ups pay.

debt.name: Loans
debt.ask: Does it owe a lot of money?
debt.explain: Can its profit comfortably pay the interest on what it owes?
debt.G: No debt, or profit pays the interest 3 times or more.
debt.A: Profit pays the interest 1.5 to 3 times.
debt.R: Interest is hard to cover, or debt is growing while margin falls.

ceo.name: Boss’s shares
ceo.ask: Is the boss selling their shares?
ceo.explain: Have the people running the company been selling their own shares lately?
ceo.G: No share sales in the last 3 quarters.
ceo.A: One sale in the last 3 quarters.
ceo.R: Sales in 2 or more of the last 3 quarters.

detail.customers: {{pct}}% of customers stay. Net change this quarter: {{net}}.
detail.ceoNone: No share sales in the last 3 quarters.
detail.ceoSales: {{n}} share sales in the last 3 quarters.

pitch.tip: You get two questions per pitch. Asking costs nothing and every answer shows real numbers. You can also invest without asking, but then you are guessing.

trade.gainLoss: Gain or loss on this part
trade.whyHint: Pick the reason closest to your real thinking. Nothing is marked right or wrong here, but it shapes your feedback.
trade.notEnough: Not enough cash for the minimum.
trade.jailed: You sat out this turn after selling in a panic. You cannot buy until next turn.

ev.downRound: sold new shares at a lower price (a down-round)
ev.failed: ran out of cash and shut down
ev.rumourSpike: price jumped on a wave of excitement

emergency.title: Pay ₹25,000 now
emergency.body: Your family needs ₹25,000 by the end of this quarter.
emergency.short: You are {{x}} short. Sell something below, then pay.
emergency.payShortNote: You cannot cover all of it. The rest becomes a loan.
emergency.owed: You owe {{x}} after the family emergency.

lesson.replayUsed: You have used this year's replay.
lesson.replayHint: Go back to the start of this quarter and decide again. Same market, same luck.
lesson.calm: This is about what the data showed, not about being wrong. You can replay the quarter once a year.

report.title: Your judgement report
report.cleared: Stage cleared. Your lamp is lit.
report.notCleared: Not cleared yet. Replay and ask better questions.

research.name: Research
research.body: Did you ask before you invested?

skepticism.name: Skepticism
skepticism.body: Did you spot the risky companies in time?

spread.name: Spread
spread.body: Was your money spread across different sectors?

calm.name: Calm and patience
calm.body: Did you stay steady in a falling market?

habits.name: Money habits
habits.body: Fees, a cushion for emergencies, idle cash.

report.profitNote: Shown for information. It never decides the result.
report.luck: You finished ahead, but part of that was luck.
report.unlucky: You finished behind, but your method was mostly sound.
report.toolkitNone: Play a few quarters to earn terms for your toolkit.
report.closing: Real markets are harder than this game. This teaches how to ask good questions, not what to buy.
